SEARCH
Package presentation.views.match

Class MatchView

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
presentation.views.View
presentation.views.match.MatchView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArcadeMatchView, SurvivalMatchView, TournamentMatchView
public abstract class MatchView extends View
Generic view for the matches (arcade, survival...). It has the parts every match uses: players HUD, scoreboard, time and pause button, the pause card and the result card. Everything it shows comes from the domain (the GUI gives it the values). Layouts: only BorderLayout, GridLayout and FlowLayout (padding with empty borders).
